value.rationale: For a canonical simple Jordan-algebra family the theorem completely determines the first nonzero rank stratum in every dimension and every field of characteristic not two, including a geometric bundle description. In odd dimensions the exact finite-field number distinguishes quadratic discriminant types, whereas in even dimensions it does not. This is a natural classification and arithmetic boundary not supplied by the general square-zero property; it does not rely on narrow arbitrarily chosen numerical parameters.
